name: fix155_crash_recovery
verifies: fix-155 [owner]: crash recovery - the hidden recovery snapshot (port option 'Crash recovery', default Yes) is written through the save system, serialized on the main thread under ~5 ms, never listed in the load list nor taken by Continue; after an unclean exit (simulated here) the confirm box asks 'Игра завершилась некорректно. Восстановить прогресс от <date>?' only while the snapshot is newer than every normal save; No discards it, Yes loads it as the visible slot 'recovered' (Восстановление), which Continue then picks
steps: safe; notips; time 12; lang Russian Russian
notes: One question per run: after the first answer (No) the offer is not repeated (expect !recovery:asked), as at the title. The Yes path (copy to 'recovered', load, Continue picks it) runs in fix155_crash_recovery_yes. A real crash test: start the game (title), play > 2 min (log '[Myrtana] recovery snapshot ... KB: serialized in X ms'), kill the process (Task Manager), start again: the title asks; Esc / No discards, Yes loads.
